notes:
Snapshot: Axion is a specialty apparel marketplace with ~4.2M SKUs (incl. variants). Focused on replacing legacy keyword search + boosting conversions with semantic search + candidate reranking. Key priorities: control cost per query during holiday spikes, 95th pct latency <= 200ms for product search endpoints, and ability to rerank top-K candidates server-side.

What they tried: PoC with Pinecone + custom reranker on infra; found vector storage and egress at scale to be expensive and inconsistent for reranking latency. Elastic-based synonyms + learning-to-rank is brittle for long-tail queries.

POC goals: index ~4M product embeddings, support 10k qps peak-to-burst (expected 4-6x baseline on Black Friday), end-to-end p95 <= 180ms for search+rerank (target), cost per query target <$0.005 averaged — willing to accept higher p50. Evaluate: Redwood Dedicated with caching + prefix KV, fallback routing to smaller quantized model during peaks, and Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization.

Security/ops: VPC/private control plane preferred; audit logs required for product updates; retention 90 days for query logs; KMS integration required. Legal asked for SOC2 + data residency notes.

Timeline & recent activity (bulleted):
- 2026-02-18: Initial intro call (Jordan) — discovery on catalog size and spike profile.
- 2026-02-28: Product demo — showcased streaming generation + rerank hooks (Fireflies ff-2026-02-28-AXN-demo).
- 2026-03-04: POC kickoff with SE (Maya) — agreed to baseline dataset (1M sampled embeddings) and synthetic traffic generator.
- 2026-03-07: Security questionnaire submitted; legal asked for ISO docs and KMS architecture diagram.
- 2026-03-09: Lightweight benchmark run: dedicated small cluster w/ quantized 7B reranker; observed p95 260ms (too high) and cost ~$0.008/q. Notes: batching helped p50 but increased p95 for tail requests.
- Next milestone: 2-week POC traffic run starting 2026-03-15 with caching enabled, rerank top-50 candidates only, and evaluate cost+latency tradeoffs.

Quotable from the CRO: "We need search that doesn't bankrupt us on holidays — rerank smart, cache aggressively."

Operational asks / hints:
- Want model routing to prefer smaller reranker for long-tail queries and high-cost fallback.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization + autoscaling policies tuned to seasonal spikes.
- Prefers per-route dashboards (token-level cost) and ability to set automatic fallback when cost>threshold.

Open questions for AE/SE:
- Can Dedicated support their 10k qps burst without overspending?
- How will prefix caching interact with frequent catalog updates (~daily feeds)?
- Expected egress/storage cost comparison vs existing Pinecone baseline.

Next steps (short):
- Maya to run targeted rerank micro-benchmarks with 3 model sizes by 2026-03-12.
- Jordan to share procurement timeline and preliminary pricing sheet.
- Diego to schedule security sync with legal (requested ISO artefacts).
